title: Skill eval per-model score file
description: Shape of one model's score file, the attachment a run record's `scores[].file` points at (see eval-run.schema.json). One file per model actually run, named by that model's full identifier rather than a short alias. Additional keys are permitted so a run may carry per-model context this contract does not anticipate.

model_id.description: The full, current model identifier actually invoked -- the same string this model is keyed to in the run record's `models` map. Never a short alias: an alias can resolve to a different underlying model later, and this file is a permanent record of what really ran.

n_fixtures.description: How many fixtures this model was scored on. Stated rather than inferred from the array length, so a truncated or partially written file disagrees with itself loudly instead of reading as a smaller complete run.

mean_score.description: The mean of this file's per-fixture scores, on the same [0,1] scale the Precondition gate requires of any scorer. Recorded at the precision the scorer published it at: a gate comparison against a differently-rounded prior is ambiguous input, and SKILL.md's Gate step fails loudly on one rather than arbitrating it.

scores.description: Per-fixture results, sorted by `fixture_id` so two runs of the same corpus produce a stable diff.

fixture_id.description: The fixture's own declared identifier, as the fixture file states it -- not a positional index, which stops meaning anything the moment the corpus grows.

score.description: This fixture's score on the [0,1] scale.

split.description: Optional. Which split this fixture belongs to. Recording it lets a reader confirm that the gate verdict was computed over the selection split alone, rather than trusting that it was.
